summary.quick_take: Webflow and Strikingly both sit in the broader website builder landscape, but they appeal to slightly different buying motions. Webflow leans into recurring payouts, while Strikingly leans into mixed payout terms. The better fit depends on whether you want the cleaner affiliate story, the broader positioning angle, or both.
